`dump\CUSA14876` (base game) and `dump\CUSA14876-patch` (v01.21 update).
AMD FSR 3.1 for Vulkan, with four patches from GetLostIn/CTR-NitroFueled-PC

implementations.acquisition_route: Upstream v0.1.0 releases are source only. On Windows, prepare the patched SDK with tools/setup-sdk.ps1 and locally build the base game with tools/build-nx.ps1 from the owned disc profile. tools/launch.ps1 -Collection is an optional shared game-selection route after each title is separately prepared. No public compiled game/player archive is offered by the reviewed README; original files stay in the local assets folder.
implementations.source_requirements: Own Xbox 360 F.E.A.R. title565507D9 default.xex and Game/ under port-nx/assets/. Exact region/revision/hash is not established by this retained README; inspect docs/SETUP.md before source acceptance. F.E.A.R. Files title565507E8 belongs to its separate catalog game. Optional PC textures require the corresponding owned PC files.
implementations.maturity: Upstream reports base-game boot, menus, intro videos, campaign and Instant Action, with display-paced high-frame-rate fixes and checkpoint/Continue behavior. Full base campaign and the 360 bonus mission have not been completely checked; Interval2 GPU spikes, soft fonts and other effects/performance work remain. Steam Deck evidence uses experimental Proton; native Linux is untested and Android ARM64 not started. No Portcove runtime or gameplay qualification.

implementations.next_action: Guarded-update existing #3183 and its stable private listing to the base F.E.A.R. Xbox360 profile, preserving receipt/history. Reconcile and intake the separate Files game under the same upstream implementation with a distinct game key.

proof.text: **Latest release: [v0.1.0](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/releases/tag/v0.1.0)**, source only and early: both games boot and play, with a lot of optimization left. **Next: 1.0**, once every level of both games has been played to the end without a crash ([Road to 1.0](#road-to-10)).

The 360 version came out about a year after the PC original and is the more complete one: **Instant Action** mode, a dual-wieldable machine pistol and an extra bonus level that the PC never got. It has been stuck on the console ever since, at 720p and 30 fps. This project frees it, and *F.E.A.R. Files* (Extraction Point + Perseus Mandate, 360) comes along too, so the whole F.E.A.R. 1 package lives in one place.

| ⏳ *F.E.A.R. Files* (Extraction Point + Perseus Mandate) | plays at 4K and 80 fps with its own PC texture pack (7,607 textures) and F.E.A.R.'s right-stick fix: "running really well… ran better out of the box than Fear 1 did"; still to do: the smoke plumes, its own effects ([#51](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/issues/51)), an optimisation pass and the full play-through ([#57](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/issues/57)). The collection: [docs/FILES.md](docs/FILES.md) |
| ⏳ Steam Deck (Proton), experimental | median 89 fps on a Deck OLED, heaviest scenes about 74 (#28, #40; [video](https://youtu.be/6rP_icfY-sM)); `tools/steamdeck/README-SteamDeck.txt` |
| ⏳ Linux | the renderer is Vulkan already; build untested |
| ⏳ Android (ARM64) | scoped, not started: what the SDK already has and what's missing ([#44](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/issues/44)) |
## Build and run (Windows)

Releases are source only: you build the game from your own discs ([v0.1.0](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/releases/tag/v0.1.0) is the latest). **Step by step: [docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md)**; what 1.0 will have: [docs/RELEASE-1.0.md](docs/RELEASE-1.0.md). In short, with the toolchain in `.tools/` and your discs extracted:
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/build-nx.ps1 -Project port-files   # F.E.A.R. Files

primary_lines.text: > The first native PC port of thatgamecompany's *flOw*, rebuilt from the PS3 binary through static recompilation.

This project takes the PS3 `EBOOT.elf` binary, disassembles all PowerPC functions, lifts them to C, and links against [ps3recomp](https://github.com/sp00nznet/ps3recomp) — a set of HLE runtime libraries that replace the PS3 operating system with native host implementations. The result is a standalone Windows executable that runs flOw natively, no emulator required.

*flOw's Level 3 rendering natively on Windows via static recompilation — the ocean gradient, drifting plankton, and the player organism (red), drawn through a D3D12 backend on top of the recompiled engine's own initialization.*
| Engine init | **Complete** | PhyreEngine created, 12 subsystems, vtables resolved |
- **ELF data snapshot system** — protects 1.3MB of zeroed GOT entries, OPDs, and vtables

- **ps3recomp sister repo — new PRX toolchain**: `tools/prx_relocate.py` (segment-aware relocator), `tools/prx_exports.py` (NID→addr export tables), `ppu_lifter --symbol-prefix` (multi-image linking), `elf_parser` module_info/export fixes, and `runtime/prx/prx_loader` (load + register + resolve). End-to-end tested against real libsre.

source_contract_lines.text: An unofficial native Windows port of the original Xbox version of **Genma Onimusha**, made by statically recompiling the game's executable to C++ with [Xbox XBE Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBERecomp).
**Latest release: [v0.5.1](../../releases/tag/v0.5.1)** · [all releases](../../releases)

> This repository and its releases contain **no game code and no game assets**. You need your own legally acquired copy of the game. The release builds the game's code on your PC, from your copy, on the first start.

3. On the first start it asks for your copy of the game: pick the disc image (`.iso`, a full redump image or an XISO), or `default.xbe` in a folder with the game's files. You can also put the `.iso` in the `assets` folder beforehand.
The release is made for **Genma Onimusha (USA)**, `default.xbe` SHA-1 `08bfe432eb55877b5af2dd401b713743c5b751cd` (redump). Another release of the game gets a warning before it is built.

The left stick uses modern movement relative to the camera. Holding the same stick direction through a camera cut preserves the character's actual heading; release the stick or change its direction to adopt the new view. The D-pad keeps the original tank controls and takes priority. Hold guard and use the stick for native directional steps and dodges. Attacks and target selection retain the game's native behavior.
Logs: the first start writes `work/build.log`, the game writes `game/logs/`.
- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- A CPU with SSE4.2 (x86-64-v2: Intel from 2008, AMD from 2011)

| [v0.5.1](../../releases/tag/v0.5.1) | Fix analog movement through camera cuts: retain the character's actual heading, preserve it through small stick adjustments, and clear retention on guard or other action states |
| `sdk/` | Xbox XBE Recomp with this port's changes (`sdk/UPSTREAM.md`): recompiler, runtime, release launcher |
- [Xbox XBE Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBERecomp) by TGP482, the recompiler and runtime this port is built on.

excerpts.text: **Experimental native runtime for Gravity Rush Remastered and Gravity Rush 2 on Windows 10 and 11.**
The runtime is designed to execute PS4 x86-64 code natively and translate graphics to Vulkan.
The Gravity Rush-only cleanup is complete, but the runtime remains experimental:
neither game's playability has been verified.
> **No game files are included.** You need your own decrypted PS4 dump of either game:
> Gravity Rush Remastered (regional CUSA01113/CUSA01130 releases) or Gravity Rush 2
> (CUSA00547, CUSA03694, CUSA04934, or CUSA04943). Gravity Rush 2 patches target update 01.11.
> Optional: `libSceNgs2.sprx` from `/system/common/lib/` of your console placed in `system_lib/` for audio.
- **Gravity Rush 2 01.11 FPS patch** included. Gravity Rush Remastered uses its own game timing.
The launcher recognizes Gravity Rush 2 by its listed title IDs. Remastered is recognized by
CUSA01130 or a regional dump's display title (`Gravity Rush Remastered` / `Gravity Daze Remastered`).
Gravity Rush 2 bundled executable patches are limited to update 01.11; other versions run
without those patches. `BB_FPS=30` disables the bundled FPS patch.
Gravity Rush Remastered is prepared without bundled executable patches.
Title/version checks do not verify executable fingerprints. A matching clean dump is needed.
PS Vita dumps and macOS runtime execution are unsupported.
- Python suite: **130 tests run — 79 passed, 51 skipped**.
- Three standalone C++ checks passed: command-buffer ownership, motion-history utilities,
and UI-composition utilities. These do not verify in-game rendering.
- Full native build: **not verified**. CMake configuration stopped because Vulkan headers
and libraries are missing from the macOS development environment.
- Windows gameplay: **not verified** for either game.

primary_lines.text: A native macOS build of the PlayStation version of *JoJo's Bizarre Adventure* (Capcom, 1999, US release SLUS-01060).
- The 1v1 fight engine (shared fight code, the main loop, scheduling, hit tests, animation) runs natively: 918 functions, checked against 97,634 captured states with no mismatches.

- All 22 selectable characters, the 4 encounter-only bosses (as the second player), all 33 stages, VS and training mode and their select screens have native code. 3,573 of those 7,188 functions are verified so far. The others still run as recompiled MIPS until a test route reaches them.

[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains the recompilation, how native functions replace recompiled ones, and how they are checked. The tools that generate and verify the native code (decompiler scripts, the C generator, the capture and replay harness) and the full phase reports are in the development repository, jojo-hftf-native-tools.

Linux · PowerPC → native C recompilation · Vulkan · Wayland · Multi-image ABI v5

> the Xbox 360 disc. The repository contains no game code, assets or executables. It does contain
errors, reproducibly, and links with the adapted SpeedBreaker runtime into a native arm64
game's PowerPC code into C++ ahead of time, and that C++ compiles to native arm64. A runtime
It builds on [SpeedBreaker](https://github.com/SpeedBreakerProject/speedbreaker), the
static recompilation of *Need for Speed: Most Wanted* (2005) by project(u). It does not
rewrite SpeedBreaker. There is no Wine, CrossOver or runtime CPU emulation.
- [reference/FEASIBILITY.md](reference/FEASIBILITY.md): disc and executable analysis, SpeedBreaker audit, risks, verdict
ReCarbon is GPL-3.0-or-later (see `COPYING` and `NOTICE`). It is derived from
[SpeedBreaker](https://github.com/SpeedBreakerProject/speedbreaker) by project(u):

excerpts.text: **[Download the latest build](https://github.com/arelkair/wiiparty-recomp/releases)** · Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) · Linux x86_64 (experimental)

Wii Party Recomp translates the game's PowerPC code into C++ and compiles it into a native Windows or Linux program. The game and Nintendo SDK code run translated; only what depends on the console hardware is replaced, and the hardware itself (GPU, DSP audio, Bluetooth, IOS, disc and NAND) is reimplemented underneath. The game's own audio microcode is recompiled too.
### Linux (experimental)
2. Download `wiipartyrecomp-launcher-x86_64.AppImage`, make it executable (`chmod +x wiipartyrecomp-launcher-x86_64.AppImage`, or Properties > Permissions in your file manager) and open it.
3. Choose your disc and press **Install**, then **Play**. The launcher downloads only nodtool; the game is installed in `~/.local/share/WiiPartyRecomp`.

The launcher needs glibc 2.38 or newer (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 39 or later) and the game needs OpenGL 4.1. The Linux version has been tested on Ubuntu 24.04 only (under WSL); reports from other distributions, desktops and graphics cards are very welcome.

- **Linux:** experimental. The launcher is an AppImage and the game plays with an OpenGL renderer, keyboard, mouse, audio, the F10 menu and custom texture packs (tested on Ubuntu 24.04; gamepad support is built in but not yet tested there). **Help wanted:** Linux testers with different GPUs and desktops, please open an issue or a discussion.
- **macOS:** planned after Linux. **Help wanted:** if you have a Mac and would like to test builds in the future, please open an issue or a discussion.

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ![Platform](docs/BuildGuide.md) This repository documents the complete journey of statically recompiling WWE '13 (Xbox 360, THQ / Yuke's, 2012) into a native PC executable using the ReXGlue SDK. The project targets both Windows (Direct3D 12) and Linux (Vulkan). Static recompilation is fundamentally different from emulation. Instead of simulating the Xbox 360 hardware at runtime, the game's original PowerPC binary is translated into portable C++23 source code ahead of time. That generated C++ is then compiled and run natively — no interpreter, no JIT, no emulator loop. This is an educational open-source project. It documents every step: environment setup, binary analysis, code generation, runtime wiring, and system-level reverse engineering. - Build a professional-quality open-source project that demonstrates real software engineering practices. observations.source_requirements: Primary-declared inputs and versions: Discussions statically recompiled GameCube code. You run your own copy of a game through a native module, and RecompCore loads it by disc ID at boot. Code the module else — graphics, audio, discs, controllers, and any code the module doesn't ISO. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ReXGlue is heavily rooted on the foundations of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator. Rather than interpreting or JIT-compiling PPC instructions at runtime, ReXGlue takes a different path: it generates C++ source code ahead of time, an approach inspired by XenonRecomp and rexdex's recompiler. Latest SDK builds and releases are published on GitHub Releases. observations.source_requirements: Primary-declared inputs and versions: - L'image disque Xbox ( .iso ) de Def Jam: Fight for NY, version USA. No game content is included. - From a release: download one of the two releases, unzip it, double-click Installer.bat and pick your .iso . - From source: clone this repository and the xboxrecomp fork (branch defjam-bringup ) side by side, then run installer.bat or installeur\installer.ps1 -Iso . Use -NoDLSS to skip DLSS and -Yes to accept all downloads.
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: Une recompilation statique de Def Jam: Fight for NY (Xbox, version USA) en programme Windows natif. Le code du jeu est traduit en C, puis compilé sur votre PC à partir de votre propre image disque. > Aucun contenu du jeu n'est fourni. Ce dépôt et ses releases ne contiennent ni code ni données du jeu. L'installeur lit votre image disque, la vérifie, l'extrait et reconstruit tout sur votre machine. N'utilisez que l'image disque d'un jeu que vous possédez. - Windows 10 ou 11, 64 bits, et une carte graphique DirectX 11. ## Deux façons d'installer Il y a deux releases. Choisissez-en une dans Releases, dézippez-la, puis double-cliquez Installer.bat et choisissez votre image disque. L'extraction, la traduction en C et la compilation prennent quelques minutes. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: > Turn any Xbox game binary into a native Windows executable. No emulation. No interpreter. Just raw, recompiled C. This is a complete toolkit for statically recompiling original Xbox (2001-2005) games from their retail XBE executables into native Windows programs. Static recompilation takes the raw x86 machine code from an Xbox binary and translates every function — every mov , every jmp , every call — into equivalent C source code. That C code compiles with MSVC into a native x86-64 .exe that runs on modern Windows. The game's original logic executes directly on your CPU, not through an interpreter or JIT compiler. Microsoft got here first: their internal Ficl/Fission recompiler shipped Xbox Microsoft's Own Recompiler. - Native performance — recompiled code runs at full speed, no interpretation overhead - Portability — the C output can target any platform with

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: # GoldenEye 007 - Native Steam Deck Build A fully native Vulkan build of GoldenEye 007 (Xbox 360 XBLA) for Steam Deck. Other Linux approaches run the Windows binary through Proton, which crashes on AMD GPUs due to VKD3D rejecting a degenerate bloom texture descriptor. This build compiles natively for Linux and talks directly to Vulkan — bypassing the crash entirely. - Bundled glibc: SteamOS ships an older glibc than required, so we bundle the Arch Linux runtime libs. ## Building from source See BUILDING.md for full build instructions.

The PowerPC code inside the game's default.xex is translated ahead of time into C++, then compiled into a native 64-bit ARM ( arm64-v8a ) binary with the Android NDK. There is no JIT and no instruction interpreter at runtime — the game's own logic runs directly on the device's CPU. What the ReXGlue runtime provides is everything *around* that: Xbox 360 kernel calls, the virtual filesystem, AAudio/SDL audio, input mapping, and the Xenos GPU translation to Vulkan. You need your own copy of the game. This repository contains no game data, no default.xex , no ROMs, and no copyrighted game assets — and it never will. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: > Turn any Xbox game binary into a native Windows executable. No emulation. No interpreter. Just raw, recompiled C. This is a complete toolkit for statically recompiling original Xbox (2001-2005) games from their retail XBE executables into native Windows programs. Static recompilation takes the raw x86 machine code from an Xbox binary and translates every function — every mov , every jmp , every call — into equivalent C source code. That C code compiles with MSVC into a native x86-64 .exe that runs on modern Windows. The game's original logic executes directly on your CPU, not through an interpreter or JIT compiler. It isn't an emulator: the Xbox 360 game was statically recompiled with the ReXGlue SDK by the PC port, and this app runs that same code on ReXGlue's PS5 platform layer, drawing with Vulkan (Mesa RADV). > No game files are included. You need your own Xbox 360 copy of SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 as a disc image ( .iso ). Everything else is in the download: the app, the hub, and the PC port's shaders, PlayStation button icons and bundled mods. - Find Mods: the Mods page looks for .svrmod files on a USB drive, extended storage or any folder on the console, and installs them from there (one, or all of a folder's). Get Mods (Triangle) shows a QR code to the Discord where people share them. - The PC port's extras: .svrmod mods, your own entrance music and movies, up to 10 H

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ReXGlue is heavily rooted on the foundations of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator. Rather than interpreting or JIT-compiling PPC instructions at runtime, ReXGlue takes a different path: it generates C++ source code ahead of time, an approach inspired by XenonRecomp and rexdex's recompiler. Latest SDK builds and releases are published on GitHub Releases. Join the Discord server for updates and share what you have created. - Loreaxe - Core contributor of the Linux/POSIX, ARM, and Vulkan feature sets. - XenonRecomp - For pioneering the modern static recompilation approach for Xbox 360. A lot of the codegen analysis logic and instruction translations are based on their work. Thank you! - rexdex's recompiler - The OG static recompiler for Xbox 360.

observations.source_requirements: Primary-declared inputs and versions: The current bring-up target is a review copy build dated Dec 5 2005 because it is symbol rich. Its PDB and MAP data let us recover meaningful function names and a source-like tree. If the port reaches a useful playable state, the plan is to evaluate moving to a retail default.xbe without throwing away the recovered source layout, runtime work, or game-specific fixes. The newest level-rendering investigation is focused on getting a correct native world frame instead of a diagnostic projection. main.tex archive parsing and texture decode are in place, real level texture records are discoverable, and the D3D bridge now tracks texture-register surfaces and packed vertex metadata. A bad generic decompression candidate was also found and removed: palette constant c30 was being reused as a normalized-vertex decompression source for unrelated world batches,
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: > A native Linux bring-up of the original Xbox build using the xboxrecompforlinux runtime. This project recompiles the original Xbox executable for Full Spectrum Warrior: Ten Hammers into a native Linux binary. Game files are not included in this repository. The current bring-up target is a review copy build dated Dec 5 2005 because it is symbol rich. Its PDB and MAP data let us recover meaningful function names and a source-like tree. If the port reaches a useful playable state, the plan is to evaluate moving to a retail default.xbe without throwing away the recovered source layout, runtime work, or game-specific fixes. This is a complete toolkit for statically recompiling original Xbox (2001-2005) games from their retail XBE executables into native programs: Windows first, with Linux and macOS (x86-64 and arm64) hosts too. Static recompilation takes the raw x86 machine code from an Xbox binary and translates every function — every mov , every jmp , every call — into equivalent C source code. observations.implementation: A native PC port of Burger King: Sneak King
observations.source_requirements: Primary-declared inputs and versions: *Burger King: Sneak King* (2006, Blitz Games) for the original Xbox, statically recompiled into a native Windows game and an experimental WebAssembly browser build. No emulator: every function of the game's default.xbe is lifted from x86 to C, then compiled for the host with a small model of the Xbox around it. This repo contains no game data. You need a dump of your own disc. The ISO, the extracted files, the analysis and the lifted code all stay on your machine, and .gitignore covers them. - 3. Dump the disc 1. Lift. The xboxrecomp toolkit, vendored in xboxrecomp/ with our patches, unpacks the disc, finds the game's roughly 13,650 functions and turns each one into C in src/recomp/gen/ . Guest registers become globals and guest memory accesses become macros into one block of host memory. Setup takes four stages. You install the tools, dump your disc
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: *Burger King: Sneak King* (2006, Blitz Games) for the original Xbox, statically recompiled into a native Windows game and an experimental WebAssembly browser build. No emulator: every function of the game's default.xbe is lifted from x86 to C, then compiled for the host with a small model of the Xbox around it. One checkout builds two versions of the game: - Windows (Direct3D 9). This is the main version. It plays the whole game with keyboard and mouse or a pad. It adds widescreen, 360 HD textures, a debug overlay with cheats, and two joke modes. - Setup - 5a. Build and run on Windows - 5b. Build and run in the browser - Builds 3. Graphics. The game's Direct3D 8 calls are intercepted and replayed on the host: Direct3D 9 on Windows ( src/d3d9_hle.c ), WebGL2 in the browser ( src/gl_hle.c ). The NV2A vertex programs are translated to HLSL or GLSL. - Windows: src/ma

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: Experimental static recompilation of the Xbox 360 build of *Spider-Man: Shattered Dimensions* using the ReXGlue SDK, for educational and research purposes. > What this is: ReXGlue statically recompiles the game's PowerPC code into C++ ahead of time, which is then compiled natively. ReXGlue is experimental and pre-1.0. Expect to manually specify function boundaries, provide missing kernel imports, and iterate on codegen output. If you just want to play the game, use Xenia. Clang 20+ The SDK enforces Clang. This repository contains the Apple host, controller bridge, reproducible portability patches and build scripts. It is not affiliated with the game publisher or an official release. Подробнее — в разделе Юридическая сторона. A[Оригинальная играROM / ISO / EXE] --> B[Дизассемблированиеассемблер] PS1, PS2 Образ диска ( .bin/.cue , .iso ) Снять образ со своего диска в ПК-приводе GameCube, Wii Образ ( .iso , .rvz ) Дамп диска на своей консоли с homebrew Xbox 360 Образ или распакованные файлы, default.xex Дамп диска со своей консоли / привода Проверяй версию и хэш. Многие рекомпиляции требуют конкретную версию (часто — US, rev. 0). В README проекта обычно указан SHA-1 или MD5. Проверка: Get-FileHash .\game.z64 -Algorithm SHA1 1. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: Как играть в Zelda, Mario, Sonic, Diablo, GTA и ещё 1800+ классических игр нативно на ПК, Mac, Linux, Android и в браузере — без эмулятора, в 60+ FPS, широкоформатно и с модами. > TL;DR. Энтузиасты по всему миру «разбирают» старые игры обратно в исходный код (декомпиляция) или автоматически переводят машинный код консоли в код для ПК (статическая рекомпиляция). Получаются нативные порты: Ocarina of Time, Majora's Mask, Mario 64, Sonic Unleashed, Twilight Princess, Diablo, Morrowind работают на Windows, macOS, Linux, Android и Switch лучше оригинала — 60/120 FPS, ultrawide, моды, онлайн-кооп. Сами проекты не содержат игр: нужен файл (ROM/образ/данные) от твоей копии. Ниже — что это такое, как запустить за 5 минут, рейтинг лучших проектов на русском, каталоги по типам и платформам, мини-курс «как декомпилировать самому», FAQ и глоссарий.Лучший GAmedev ресурс - сама

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ReXGlue is heavily rooted on the foundations of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator. Rather than interpreting or JIT-compiling PPC instructions at runtime, ReXGlue takes a different path: it generates C++ source code ahead of time, an approach inspired by XenonRecomp and rexdex's recompiler. Latest SDK builds and releases are published on GitHub Releases. Join the Discord server for updates and share what you have created. ## Builds Release ![win-amd64](https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk/actions/workflows/build-win-amd64.yaml) ![linux-amd64](https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk/actions/workflows/build-linux-amd64.yaml) ![linux-arm64](https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk/actions/workflows/build-linux-aarch64.yaml) Latest stable Nightly ![nightly](https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk/actions/workflows/nightly.yaml) Latest pre-release - Loreaxe - Linux Contributo

Their location is set in CMakeUserPresets.json — point it at your own copy. Copy your game data to a public folder — from Android 11 on, adb push You need your own legally-obtained copy to build or run anything here.
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: # Skate 3 — Android port An Android (arm64) port of Skate 3 Recompiled. The Xbox 360 game is statically recompiled to native code — this is not an emulator: the PowerPC game code is translated to C++ and compiled to real aarch64, with Vulkan for the Android target on top: app shell, touch controls, and the platform fixes - Emulator (BlueStacks, Android 9, x86_64 with host GPU passthrough) — reaches - Phone — Redmi 13 (Android 15, arm64, Mali‑G52 MC2) — boots and reaches the ## Requirements - arm64-v8a, Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer ### Building - Android NDK r29 leaves unresolved calls and the build will not link. git clone leaves those directories empty and the build fails with a confusing git clone --recursive https://github.com/luisxl15/SKATE-3-ANDROID-PORT.git ## Building ### The short way (Windows)

Latest SDK builds and releases are published on GitHub Releases. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: A native Windows port of the original Xbox game *Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone* (2003), made by static recompilation: the game's x86 code is translated to C and compiled for Windows, with the Xbox kernel, This repository contains no game content. Download the repository, build the executables and put your disc's files or the .xiso in a game folder beside the executables and start hpps_launcher.exe . observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: xbox-on-deb runs original Xbox games natively on Linux. Each game's XBE is statically recompiled to C and built as a Windows x64 executable that runs under GE-Proton. StarCraft: Ghost (the leaked May 2004 Xbox build) is the first game shipped this way. It boots, reaches the menus, and plays missions with audio, controller, and keyboard-and-mouse input. - GE-Proton in ~/.steam/root/compatibilitytools.d/ . The windows-on-deb scripts 01 to 03 install it with Steam and the system packages. - cmake , git , and uv . In-game rendering is handled by a custom Vulkan backend built on the open-source Mesa/NVK graphics driver. The game runs on standard Switch hardware clocks with no overclock required. > This repository contains no game assets, copyrighted audio, video, or textures. You must supply your own copy of the Xbox 360 disc: either an uncompressed image ( .iso / .xiso ), multi-disc images (Disc 1 + Disc 2), or an extracted folder structure with default.xex . Currently, supported releases include Mass Effect (USA, Europe) (En,Es,Pl) (Rev 1) and Mass Effect (Russian Edition - 1C) (supporting full Russian voiceover and text). Check docs/edition

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: > Turn any Xbox game binary into a native Windows executable. No emulation. No interpreter. Just raw, recompiled C. page: picking a target from your ISOs, running the pipeline, building, the boot This is a complete toolkit for statically recompiling original Xbox (2001-2005) games from their retail XBE executables into native Windows programs. Static recompilation takes the raw x86 machine code from an Xbox binary and translates every function — every mov , every jmp , every call — into equivalent C source code. That C code compiles with MSVC into a native x86-64 .exe that runs on modern Windows. The game's original logic executes directly on your CPU, not through an interpreter or JIT compiler. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: It is not an Xbox 360 runtime and does not contain a second CPU, memory system, kernel, XAM implementation, filesystem, audio stack, input stack, content system or Xenos renderer. Those belong to Xenon. Gracemeria supplies only title-specific information needed to identify, analyse and recompile Ace Combat 6, plus AC6-specific compatibility knowledge that remains valid on Xenon's runtime. The generated native library uses Xenon's canonical Xenon_BindCompiledRegistry ABI. Gracemeria does not invent a title-specific loader. ## Build the migration tools Requirements: CMake 3.25+, a C++20 compiler, Ninja (recommended), Python 3 for metadata tests, and the current Xenon source tree. cmake -S . -B build/dev -G Ninja \ -DGRACEMERIA_BUILD_TESTS=ON cmake --build build/dev ctest --test-dir build/dev --output-on-failure ./build/dev/gracemeria-recomp /path/to/default.xex gen

Put a dump of a disc you own under roms/ . See the commands above, and Win32 development setup and build for the full procedure. The argument is the game directory extracted from the disc. The app serves that folder as the game's D: and loads default.xbe , an Xbox title's default executable. --xbe loads another XBE, for example --xbe SegaJSRF.xbe on a disc that carries Sega GT and JSRF together. Before the first build, put the game files under roms\J

APP["app: rejsrf"] --> GAME["game/jsrf: recompiled + decompiled JSRF code, title profile"] RT --> PLAT["third_party/rexbox platform: win32 / linux / web / android"] .\scripts\build_win32_x86.ps1 -Configuration Release -Target rexbox_xdk_symbols .\scripts\build_win32_x86.ps1 # US판용. 일본판용은 -Variant jp (build\win32_x86_jp) .\build\win32_x86\src\app\Debug\rejsrf.exe "roms\Jet Set Radio Future" .\build\win32_x86\src\app\Debug\rejsrf.exe "roms\Jet Set Radio Future" --xbe SegaJSRF.xbe US판과 일본판을 모두 지원합니다. 실행 파일 하나는 한 판만 실행하며, 어느 판으로 빌드할지는 -Variant us jp (CMake -DREJSRF_VARIANT=jsrf_us jsrf_jp )로 정합니다. 판은 파일 이름이 아니라 내용으로 식별합니다(재생성 스크립트는 MD5, 앱은 인증서). 빌드한 판과 다른 XBE를 주면 어느 판으로 빌드해야 하는지 알리고 멈춥니다. 언어(English / Japanese)는 두 판 모두 설정 메뉴의 Game 탭에서 고릅니다. observations.source_requirements: Primary-declared inputs and versions: A native Windows x86_64 ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompilation of Samurai Shodown Sen (*Edge of Destiny* / サムライスピリッツ閃) for the Xbox 360 (Title ID: 534E07D5 , Media ID: 7DA5732F ), built using ReXGlue and x360tools. * AOT Static Binary Translation: The game executable ( default.xex ) was unpacked and translated into ~24,569 optimized C++ functions via x360tools . * Guest Memory Virtualization: Maps a 4GB guest virtual memory arena at base 0x0000000100000000 with direct address virtualization for game data, stack frames, and DMA structures. * If this function returns anything other than 0 ( ERROR_SUCCESS ) or 4306 ( ERROR_EMPTY ), menu input is discarded completely. ├── extracted/ # Game data extracted from Xbox 360 ISO │ ├── default.xex
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: A native Windows x86_64 ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompilation of Samurai Shodown Sen (*Edge of Destiny* / サムライスピリッツ閃) for the Xbox 360 (Title ID: 534E07D5 , Media ID: 7DA5732F ), built using ReXGlue and x360tools. * 100% Native Subsystem: Built as a native Windows GUI application ( WIN32 subsystem), executing cleanly without command-line windows or terminal console attachments. The original Xbox 360 title depends on hardware-assisted video decoders for its opening logos and cinematic movies. In recompiled environments, missing video hardware interrupts caused the engine to freeze in an infinite decode poll loop: ├── samsho_sen/ # Recompiled C++ project ├── samshosen.exe # 100% Native Windows GUI executable ## Requirements * Operating System: Windows 10 (version 1903+) or Windows 11 64-bit. * Audio: Standard Windows audio device (DirectSound / WASAPI / XAudio2)

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: Liberty Recompiled is an unofficial PC port of the Xbox 360 version of Grand Theft Auto IV created through the process of static recompilation. The port aims to offer Windows, Linux, and macOS support. This project does not include any game assets. You must provide the files from your own legally acquired copy of the game to install or build Liberty Recompiled. The runtime is powered by a fork of the ReXGlue SDK (our fork), which handles PowerPC → C++ recompilation and Xenos shader translation. The development of static recompilation tooling in this space was directly inspired by N64: Recompiled, which was used to create Zelda 64: Recompiled. - Building - [x] Cross-platform build system (Windows, Linux, macOS) - [x] Installer wizard with ISO/folder/XContent support Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\LibertyRecomp\ Linux ~/.local/share/LibertyRecomp/ macOS ~/Library/Applicati

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ReXGlue is heavily rooted on the foundations of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator. Rather than interpreting or JIT-compiling PPC instructions at runtime, ReXGlue takes a different path: it generates C++ source code ahead of time, an approach inspired by XenonRecomp and rexdex's recompiler. Latest SDK builds and releases are published on GitHub Releases. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: A native PC port of Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation built on top of the ReXGlue SDK. The Xbox 360 PowerPC game code is statically recompiled to x86-64, while visible rendering currently remains authoritative in the vendored RexGlue/Xenia graphics backend. This is a fork of sal063/AC6_recomp, adding Linux support. Two things differ from upstream: - No prebuilt binaries. The ReXGlue SDK is vendored as source only; upstream's prebuilt host binaries ( tools/binutils/ , the Dear ImGui example libs) are removed because nothing in the build references them. See thirdparty/rexglue-sdk/VENDORED.md for the pinned commit and the full list of local patches. - Linux port. Host-dependent code moved behind src/ac6_port/ , plus fixes in the vendored SDK for POSIX signal handling, event synchronisation, sockets, and codegen. XISO game-data streaming 🟢 Implemented — Default Testing through Chapters 1–3 has so far shown stable runtime behaviour. However, later portions of the game have not yet been validated to the same extent, and additional compatibility issues may still be discovered as testing progresses. - Game-data handling and XISO streaming The game-data loading system has also been updated to use XISO streaming
observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ### Experimental native recompilation for modern Windows SM2-Recomp is an unofficial project that recompiles the original Xbox release of Spider-Man 2 for native execution on modern Windows systems. The project translates code from a user-supplied original Xbox executable into native code and provides the Xbox-facing runtime behaviour needed by the game on modern Windows systems. Development is still active. Current builds have demonstrated sustained in-game execution through at least Chapters 1–3 during testing, and the major rendering corruption seen during early development has been resolved. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: ps3recomp is an open-source toolkit that provides the runtime libraries, system stubs, and analysis tools needed to statically recompile PlayStation 3 games into native PC executables. Instead of interpreting or dynamically recompiling PowerPC/SPU instructions at runtime (what emulators like RPCS3 do brilliantly), we take the opposite approach: translate everything ahead of time into C/C++ that compiles with your favorite compiler on any modern platform. - Lower hardware requirements — runs on mid-range PCs - Moddability — recompiled C/C++ is infinitely more hackable than PPC binaries - Portability — the output is C/C++, so it can target any platform a compiler does (see platform support for where the runtime actually stands today) CI builds and tests every row on every pull request: Windows (clang-cl), macOS arm64, Linux (GCC and Clang), and Linux with the Vulka

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: > Turn any Xbox game binary into a native Windows executable. No emulation. No interpreter. Just raw, recompiled C. This is a complete toolkit for statically recompiling original Xbox (2001-2005) games from their retail XBE executables into native Windows programs. Static recompilation takes the raw x86 machine code from an Xbox binary and translates every function — every mov , every jmp , every call — into equivalent C source code. That C code compiles with MSVC into a native x86-64 .exe that runs on modern Windows. The game's original logic executes directly on your CPU, not through an interpreter or JIT compiler. Microsoft got here first: their internal Ficl/Fission recompiler shipped Xbox Microsoft's Own Recompiler. - Native performance — recompiled code runs at full speed, no interpretation overhead - Portability — the C output can target any platform with

observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: # Fallout-NV-MacOS — bring-your-own-game static recompiler for 32-bit x86 (Fallout: New Vegas on Apple Silicon) Translates the machine code of a 32-bit Windows (x86) game into C that compiles natively for Fallout: New Vegas (PC, 2010) runs natively on Apple Silicon macOS — no Wine or CrossOver: the 4. recomp/build.sh compiles it with clang into a native library. - You need a legally owned, unencrypted 32-bit Windows executable. DRM-wrapped executables are out of scope for this project; DRM-free releases work directly. ## Requirements macOS on Apple Silicon, Ghidra 12 ( brew install ghidra ), clang, Python 3.9+ with unicorn>=2.1.4 and numpy ( pip install -r requirements.txt ). Unicorn 2.1.1 crashes on recent macOS — use 2.1.4 or newer. # 2. translate, build, verify recomp/build.sh "$WORK/gen" "$WORK/build" python3 recomp/difftest.py "$GAME" "$WORK/build/librecomp.

Our destination is a readable, maintainable C++ implementation of the entire game: code people can understand, build, modify, and extend. The first launch makes a console identity for this PC and keeps it: a 12-digit serial, a MAC address, a hard-drive key, and an online key, plus the MACS key derived from those two keys. observations.acquisition_route: Upstream route evidence: A static recompilation of Midnight Club: Los Angeles (Complete Edition) for Xbox 360, targeting Windows x86-64. Built with the rexGlu SDK as a compilers class project. Static recompilation converts the original Xbox 360 PowerPC (PPC) bytecode in the game's .xex executable into native C++ that compiles and runs directly on a modern PC — no emulator, no interpreter. The game's kernel calls (file I/O, GPU commands, audio, threading) are handled by the rexGlu runtime. Ninja Build system used by all presets ### Game Data Setup ## Building # Build cmake --build out/build/win-amd64-relwithdebinfo --target midnightclub The executable is written to out/build/win-amd64-relwithdebinfo/midnightclub.exe . Visual Studio: Open the repo folder in VS 2022, select Windows AMD64 RelWithDebInfo from the configuration dropdown, and click Play. The launch.vs.json sets the correct work

primary_lines.text: > The first native PC port of thatgamecompany's *flOw*, rebuilt from the PS3 binary through static recompilation.

This project takes the PS3 `EBOOT.elf` binary, disassembles all PowerPC functions, lifts them to C, and links against [ps3recomp](https://github.com/sp00nznet/ps3recomp) — a set of HLE runtime libraries that replace the PS3 operating system with native host implementations. The result is a standalone Windows executable that runs flOw natively, no emulator required.

*flOw's Level 3 rendering natively on Windows via static recompilation — the ocean gradient, drifting plankton, and the player organism (red), drawn through a D3D12 backend on top of the recompiled engine's own initialization.*

primary_lines.text: **A work-in-progress native Windows port of the 2008 Wii release, built with ModernGekko and DolRecomp.**

This project statically translates the PowerPC code from the North American Wii release of *Destroy All Humans! Big Willy Unleashed* (`RDHE78`) into native x86-64 code. A modified ModernGekko runtime provides the Wii CPU, memory, graphics, audio and input behavior expected by the game.

Game executables, disc images, extracted assets, movies, saves, generated translation output and runtime captures are intentionally excluded from Git. Keep local inputs in the workspace paths expected by the scripts under `workstation/`.

DolRecomp translates the retail Wii executable's PowerPC machine code into C. That generated code is compiled into a native module. ModernGekko supplies the host runtime and emulates the Wii facilities that the translated code expects. Game-specific fixes are kept in runtime patches, host integration and narrowly scoped tooling where practical.

*Destroy All Humans!* and related names, characters, artwork and assets belong to their respective owners. Contributors must not submit copyrighted game data, disc images, executables, extracted assets, movies or other material they do not have permission to distribute. Third-party components retain their original licenses.

primary_lines.text: A native macOS build of the PlayStation version of *JoJo's Bizarre Adventure* (Capcom, 1999, US release SLUS-01060).
- The 1v1 fight engine (shared fight code, the main loop, scheduling, hit tests, animation) runs natively: 918 functions, checked against 97,634 captured states with no mismatches.

- All 22 selectable characters, the 4 encounter-only bosses (as the second player), all 33 stages, VS and training mode and their select screens have native code. 3,573 of those 7,188 functions are verified so far. The others still run as recompiled MIPS until a test route reaches them.

[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) explains the recompilation, how native functions replace recompiled ones, and how they are checked. The tools that generate and verify the native code (decompiler scripts, the C generator, the capture and replay harness) and the full phase reports are in the development repository, jojo-hftf-native-tools.
